description: Header file defining the nl80211_client_whm class, which implements NL80211 client methods for wireless management using the wbapi shared connection, including interface, radio, station info, survey, power, key management, and DELBA frame functions.

classes.name: nl80211_client_whm
classes.description: Implements NL80211 client methods for wireless management using shared wbapi connection.

methods.name: get_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of wireless VAP interface names.

methods.name: get_interface_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific interface, including MAC address and SSID.

methods.name: get_radio_info
methods.description: Retrieves radio capabilities and supported channels.

methods.name: get_sta_info
methods.description: Retrieves station information for a connected station.

methods.name: get_survey_info
methods.description: Returns fixed survey info for first 8 2.4GHz channels.

methods.name: set_tx_power_limit
methods.description: Sets the transmit power limit for a radio interface.

methods.name: get_tx_power_dbm
methods.description: Gets the current transmit power in dBm.

methods.name: add_key
methods.description: Adds a security key for a station.

methods.name: add_station
methods.description: Manually adds a station with association request and aid.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieves key information for a station.

methods.name: send_delba
methods.description: Sends DELBA frame to a station.
